requirements.title: Isolated checkouts never corrupt shared Git config
requirements.remaining: WorktreeManager.add() uses real `git worktree add` (not the EnterWorktree pattern), but no test asserts the shared repo's core.bare stays false, and no explicit serialization lock guards concurrent `git worktree add` calls against the shared common dir.

requirements.remaining: safe_commit()'s own docstring says it stages the COMPLETE working tree (including untracked files and deletions), the opposite of staging only explicitly reviewed paths; no reviewed-path allowlist enforcement was found.
